naslov: Clippers face the Raptors on 5-game losing streak
tekst:
Toronto Raptors (3-3, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Los Angeles Clippers (1-5, 13th in the Western Conference)
              Inglewood, California; Monday, 10 p.m. EST
              LINE: Raptors -5.5; over/under is 219.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Los Angeles aims to end its five-game slide when the Clippers play Toronto.
              Los Angeles went 42-40 overall with a 23-18 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Clippers averaged 9.0 steals, 4.9 blocks and 13.5 turnovers per game last season.
              Toronto finished 46-36 overall with a 22-19 record on the road last season. The Raptors shot 48.2% from the field and 35.4% from 3-point range last season.
              INJURIES: Clippers: Max Strus: out (foot), Yanic Konan Niederhauser: out (lisfranc), Jordan Miller: out (shoulder), Brandon Ingram: out (heel), Bradley Beal: out (knee).
              Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot).
